snippet.title: Caterva: Outsider Dreams l Reveal Trailer.
snippet.description:
Everyone in this town has had the same dream, the same nightmare, except you.

Dream alongside Milo, whose consciousness is bound to an ancient robot forgotten on a vast space station. Guided by a mysterious paper doll, you’ll explore the ruins of a civilization that once tried to escape this universe’s fate. There, you’ll encounter strange characters, solve puzzles, and piece together secrets that will reveal the true nature of CATERVA.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012060/Caterva_Outsider_Dreams/
